notes: The series of prepositional phrases is read by counting the ASV's of against the ב morphemes: in belongs to the first, and each later of to the ב standing before its noun.
תְּשׂוּמֶת יָד is fused under rule 30's one-English-word condition; the marginal reading pledge does not change the segmentation.
נֶפֶשׁ → any one keeps the supplied quantifier with the noun under rule 15, since no כֹּל or negative in the clause licenses it; head stays on the lexeme-bearing one.
